topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: There it was, nestled among the old books and forgotten trinkets, my childhood teddy bear. I hadn’t seen him in decades, yet there he was, as if he had been waiting for me. His once-bright fur was now faded, and a button eye was missing, but his gentle, familiar face was unmistakable. I picked him up, cradling him as I used to do on stormy nights. Memories flooded back, each one a warm embrace from a time long past. I paid for him without hesitation, knowing that from that day forward, he would rest where he always belonged—safe, cherished, and by my side once more.
